name: Maag Taranau
description: A floating vault above Tarnation with traps, a warded door and a treasure chamber containing a child; it flies into the clouds after being opened.

timeline.summary: Oko announces the crew will rob Maag Taranau, a vault Annie thought a myth.
timeline.quote: "We're going to rob Maag Taranau," he said at last.

timeline.summary: Ral says he wants the vault's power sealed away and proposes taking back the key and locking the treasure on another plane.
timeline.quote: We get the key back, find the treasure inside the vault, and lock it away on another plane

timeline.summary: Oko's reunited crew enters Maag Taranau, with the silent Annie leading them through traps.
timeline.quote: Annie's left iris glowed a vivid orange as she approached the outer entrance.

timeline.summary: Rocks seal Akul inside, and the vault shoots into the clouds and vanishes.
timeline.quote: the vault shot toward the clouds and vanished from sight.

relations.note: The vault floats above the city of Tarnation.
relations.quote: So—the vault floats above the city.

pages_say.description: A legendary vault, the only structure on Thunder Junction said to predate the Omenpaths, believed to hold raw power.
A jagged floating rock above Tarnation that is the vault.
The vault whose power Oko, Ral and others seek.
A floating vault above Tarnation with traps, a warded door and a treasure chamber containing a child; it flies into the clouds after being opened.
